conclusion: The CURRENT_CHUNK_EXACT_MATCH_MISSING blocker on CURRENT-STRUCTURAL-LINEAGE-01 is explained: ~70% of codebase_chunk_index rows (39,114/55,853) carry a 16-character legacy content_hash that is not, and can never be treated as, a full SHA-256 digest, so the required exact source_ref+content_hash join against graphify_execution_file_membership_v2 (uniformly 64-char SHA-256) returns zero regardless of source-ref coverage improvements. This is a data-format gap in the existing codebase_chunk_index writer history, not a path-naming, workspace-revision, or source-authority problem.

legacyHashWriterIdentified.correctedSameDay: CORRECTED 2026-09-15 (writer-completeness audit for parent-atlas-chunk-index-whole-file-hash task 1.2): the original note below said this script writes 'straight to the content_hash column' -- that is FALSE. codebase-semantic-indexer.ts has zero Postgres references (no pg/Pool/INSERT INTO anywhere in the file); its content_hash write is a QDRANT PAYLOAD field, not a Postgres column write. The real mechanism is a two-hop pipeline: this script writes the truncated hash into a Qdrant point payload (collection codebase_chunks_768); a separate script, sveltekit-frontend/scripts/mirror-qdrant-to-postgres.ts, scrolls that same collection and copies payload.content_hash verbatim into Postgres codebase_chunk_index.content_hash. See docs/reports/codebase-chunk-index-writer-audit-v1.json for full detail. The hash FORMULA/scope/length conclusion below is unaffected and remains correct.
legacyHashWriterIdentified.writer: sveltekit-frontend/scripts/codebase-semantic-indexer.ts (Qdrant payload write) + sveltekit-frontend/scripts/mirror-qdrant-to-postgres.ts (Postgres mirror write) -- a two-hop pair, not a single direct writer
legacyHashWriterIdentified.note: It IS SHA-256, not a different algorithm -- just truncated to the first 16 of 64 hex characters. Originally written into a Qdrant point payload (line 677: content_hash: chunk.contentHash, on a point later sent to Qdrant), then mirrored into Postgres by a separate script. The truncated value is also embedded in chunk_id as `card:${relPath}:${hash}`.
legacyHashWriterIdentified.priorSessionCrossReference: Independently identified in sveltekit-frontend/scripts/atlas/backfill-chunk-id-and-content-hash.mjs's own header comment (2026-08-21 session, memory/SESSION-201-EG-GGUF-PROOF-GATES-0-2.md) for a different, narrower purpose (chunk_id backfill for 6,908 NULL rows) -- this pass connects that already-documented fact to the CURRENT-STRUCTURAL-LINEAGE-01 blocker for the first time.

deeperScopeMismatchFound.description: Independent of the truncation bug, the hashed SCOPE differs between tables. graphify_execution_file_membership_v2.content_hash (and its upstream source public.graphify_files.content_hash, confirmed via scripts/atlas/apply-file-level-source-refs-content-reconciled-v1.mjs) is a WHOLE-FILE hash. codebase_chunk_index.content_hash is a PER-CHUNK hash: codebase-semantic-indexer.ts hashes one chunk's text (a partial slice of the file, line 556); the other observed writer, scripts/atlas/index-full-repo-for-search.mjs (line 607), hashes the composite string `${relPath}:${idx}:${chunkText}`, not the file either.
deeperScopeMismatchFound.implication: Even after fixing the 16-character truncation, exact source_ref+content_hash join against a whole-file hash would still fail for any file split into more than one chunk, because no codebase_chunk_index writer found this pass ever computed a whole-file hash. This is a second, independent root cause layered under the truncation bug, not solved by fixing truncation alone.
deeperScopeMismatchFound.notFullyExhausted: Only 2 of the ~19 candidate writer files found via grep (index-full-repo-for-search.mjs, codebase-semantic-indexer.ts) were read this pass; a third writer computing a genuine whole-file hash was not ruled out.
